groups.activity: check that Synapse research is complete

rows.label: Synapse
rows.note: Ghost tier: 5,000 cr, 65 Mutagen Sample, 800 Circuits, 3,000 Nano Spores, 1,200 Polymer Bundle; 3 days

conditions: A fresh solo clan has to research Embolist before Synapse.
Research costs scale with clan tier: Ghost x1, Shadow x3, Storm x10, Mountain x30, Moon x100. In an established clan it's usually done already.
Coda Synapse is a separate weapon with its own Mastery and does not substitute for this one.

groups.activity: queue every invasion that pays Mutagen Mass

rows.label: Mutagen Mass
rows.alt: Orb Vallis Lvl 30-50 bounty pays 2 per roll when its rotation shows Mutagen Mass

conditions: Invasions pay only 1-2 Mutagen Mass per completion, where Fieldron and Detonite come in 3s.
bonuses: Keep a Mutagen Mass build running in a free foundry slot while you farm invasions.

disclosures.title: build the Mass yourself
disclosures.body: The Bio Lab Mutagen Mass blueprint is 15,000 cr and single use. Each build takes 15,000 cr, 10 Mutagen Sample, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage and 250 Plastids and runs 12 hours. Farm Samples on Deimos (Terrorem survival, Hyf defense or the Cambion Drift); they are rare on Eris. Building Mass eats into any Samples your clan still needs for Bio Lab research such as Hema.

disclosures.title: the Fortuna bounty trick
disclosures.body: The tier 4 bounty's factional reward rotates between Fieldron, Detonite Injector and Mutagen Mass. When Mass is up, take a bounty with a fast first stage, clear stage 1 for the reward, let the rest fail, and restart.

disclosures.title: fast invasion clears
disclosures.body: Titania with Razorwing Blitz and a Thermal Sunder subsume clears exterminate, capture and assassinate invasions in about a minute. Skip sabotage invasions.
